subject: Quick 20-min demo for NovaCorp — pick a slot?
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Mitchell <evan@novacorp.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-14 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: Quick 20-min demo for NovaCorp — pick a slot?

Hi Evan —

Congrats on the usage uptick — I noticed NovaCorp crossed the 5M token mark this week from your testing project. That’s a strong signal that a short, targeted walkthrough could help your team get better latency/cost for streaming inference and a look at batching/cache suggestions we’ve used for similar pipelines.

Would you be open to a 20-minute call where we can:
- run a quick review of your usage pattern (I can bring the graph)
- demo a couple of optimizations (KV cache, batching profiles)
- map next steps for an eval or POC if helpful

I’m available today 11:30–12:30 PT or 3:00–4:30 PT. If those don’t work, here’s my scheduling link (pick a 20-min slot): https://cal.com/redwood/20-min-demo

If helpful, I’ll loop in Laura (CS) and Jasmine (AE) to cover implementation and pricing. Attached is a one-page demo agenda and a quick health snapshot of your recent usage.

Thanks —
Rohan Mehta
SDR, Redwood Inference
rohan@redwood.ai

Attachments: demo-agenda.pdf (1 page), novacorp-usage-report.csv (CSV summary)

From: Evan Mitchell <evan@novacorp.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-14 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick 20-min demo for NovaCorp — pick a slot?

Thanks Rohan — appreciate the heads up.

A few quick notes:
- Yes, we saw the token bump — running a new feature in prod tests (embedding-heavy).
- Primary ask: we want to see end-to-end latency improvements and an approach for reducing per-token cost without hurting quality. If you can show an example with our pattern (short prompts + long context), that would be ideal.

I’m in PT — 11:30 today would work for me. Can you include our infra lead? Carolyn Zhao (carolyn@novacorp.com) should be on the invite — she’ll ask a couple of questions about deployment options and VPC.

Also, do you have a quick note about what data you’d need from us before the call?

— Evan
Senior Product Manager, NovaCorp

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Mitchell <evan@novacorp.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, jasmine_liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-14 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick 20-min demo for NovaCorp — pick a slot?

Perfect — I’ll set 11:30–11:50 PT and include Carolyn.

For prep, nothing heavyweight — a short anonymized example request/response (2–3 sample prompts) is enough — and the rough distribution of sequence lengths (we included a CSV summary in the attachment but a couple of notes from Carolyn are helpful). We’ll use that to show how caching + a different batching profile would affect both latency and cost.

Agenda (attached):
- 00–05: quick intro + goals
- 05–15: targeted demo using your prompt samples
- 15–20: next steps / POC asks

Jasmine — can you join for the pricing/packaging quick Qs? Laura — could you bring the short implementation checklist if we get into VPC/dedicated questions?

Calendar invite: Google Meet link will be in the invite (I’ll send it shortly). If any of the proposed times don’t work, I included my Cal.com link: https://cal.com/redwood/20-min-demo

Thanks —
Rohan

One quick note on pricing: if NovaCorp is planning a short POC to validate latency improvements, we can offer an evaluation tier and a one-time credits package that covers initial load testing — we can cover details live and follow up with a short estimate afterward.

I’ll add a slide on the credits/POC flow.

Regards,

jasmine@redwood.ai

Meeting link: https://meet.google.com/lookup/redwood-novacorp-demo
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/contact/78901 (DEAL-4581)
